monday_comment: Ours: “In this morning’s meeting you cut in on Priya three times and she stopped talking. I need her ideas in the room. What did you notice?”
caption:
What would you say?

Your best performer just interrupted a quieter teammate for the third time in one meeting. The teammate stopped talking. Nobody said anything.

You have a 1:1 with your best performer in an hour.

What is your first sentence?

Ours goes in the comments on Monday.

#newmanager #leadership #management
